title: Subtree of Another Tree
keyIdea: Try every node of root as a starting point and ask isSameTree(node, subRoot): same shape and values all the way down. The first node where it's true → true; if none works → false.

approaches.name: Serialize + find
approaches.idea: Write both trees as preorder strings with NULL markers, then check if subRoot's string appears inside root's.
approaches.why: Each tree is serialized once. A plain find() can be slower in theory; KMP guarantees linear time. The markers stop false matches like "2" inside "12".

approaches.name: Try every node + isSameTree
approaches.idea: isSubtree visits each node of root; at each one runs isSameTree against subRoot; stops at the first full match.
approaches.why: isSameTree can cost up to n (size of subRoot) at each of the m nodes of root. Usually it fails within a node or two, so it's fast in practice.

quiz.q: root's node 2 has a child, subRoot is a single 2. Is subRoot a subtree there?
options: No: a subtree includes all descendants, so the extra child breaks the match
Only if the child is NULL
